description: This file defines a PHP interface for retry configuration in the AWS SDK, specifying methods to get retry mode, max attempts, and the configuration as an array.

classes.name: ConfigurationInterface
classes.description: Interface providing access to retry configuration options in the AWS SDK for PHP.

methods.name: getMode
methods.description: Returns the retry mode, which could be 'legacy', 'standard', or 'adaptive'.

methods.name: getMaxAttempts
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of retry attempts for a request.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the configuration as an associative array.
